text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: 'Issue number to address'
        required: true
        type: string
      instructions:
        description: 'Additional instructions for Claude Code'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

jobs:
  claude-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check if user is collaborator
        id: check_collaborator
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const actor = context.actor;
            
            try {
              await github.rest.repos.checkCollaborator({ owner, repo, username: actor });
              console.log(`${actor} is a collaborator`);
              return true;
            } catch (error) {
              console.log(`${actor} is not a collaborator`);
              throw new Error('Only repository collaborators can trigger this workflow');
            }

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Claude Code
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are an expert TypeScript developer working on the liam project. 
            Address the issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}.
            ${{ github.event.inputs.instructions }}
            Please make changes to fix the issue while maintaining code quality and following existing patterns in the codebase.
            Focus on the specific problem described in the issue.
          model: 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620'
          anthropic_model: 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620'
          timeout_minutes: 10
          settings: |
            {
              "max_tokens": 4096,
              "temperature": 0.5
            }

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.claude.outputs.conclusion == 'success'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: 'chore: address issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }} with Claude Code'
          title: 'fix: address issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}'
          body: |
            This PR was automatically generated by Claude Code to address issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}.
            
            ## Changes Made
            - Automatic fixes applied by Claude Code
            
            ## Context
            - Issue: #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}
            - Instructions: ${{ github.event.inputs.instructions }}
            
            Please review carefully before merging.
          branch: 'claude-fix-issue-${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}'
          base: 'main'
          draft: true
          delete-branch: false
          author: 'Claude Code <claude-code@example.com>'
          committer: 'Claude Code <claude-code@example.com>'
          signoff: false

      - name: Report failure
        if: steps.claude.outputs.conclusion == 'failure'
        run: |
          echo "Claude Code failed to generate changes"
          exit 1
```
